scope: Six fixed-version primary arXiv abstracts and metadata inspected; independent parent refetch matched all six abstract hashes. Retains abstract_checked without full-paper review or reproduction.

limitations.https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01006: A black-box audit of one hosted decision model with public and generated tasks. Self-knowledge interpretations require surface-cue controls; reported findings are not a measurement of internal mechanisms. All findings remain author-reported preprint evidence.
limitations.https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.11978: A selected multiple-choice benchmark comparison, not a universal capability ranking or closed-loop tool-use evaluation. Performance remains author-reported; no implementation was executed. All findings remain author-reported preprint evidence.
limitations.https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12292: Experiments cover seven open-weight models and synthetic tool-call policies. They are not a direct exploit result against TypeSafe hosted Jev, and do not show that every possible defense fails. All findings remain author-reported preprint evidence.
limitations.https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36399: One model, a particular values instrument and constructed personas. Model response profiles and confidence must not be treated as direct observations about actual national, age or gender groups. v2 is dated 2026-10-03; first submission was 2026-09-28. All findings remain author-reported preprint evidence.
limitations.https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15710: The authors describe preregistered hypotheses, LLM annotations and two human adjudicators including an author. Shared label-model errors and development-set selection limit cascade interpretation; no preregistration registry or experiment was independently reproduced. All findings remain author-reported preprint evidence.
limitations.https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18497: Three benchmark collections and a controlled source-relocation test. Derived references are generated by another model, not independently verified ground truth; the paper does not establish reliable acceptance of arbitrary tool calls. All findings remain author-reported preprint evidence.

deduplication: Canonical URLs, normalized paper titles and abstract hashes are new relative to the current source index and frozen expansion baseline.

independent_review.decision: Accept all six as direct primary-abstract resources, conditional on preserving scope limitations and the two visible-summary clarifications below. Curated promotion is separate from counting newly added sources.

primary_checks.observed_version_dateline: [Submitted on 28 Sep 2026 (v1), last revised 3 Oct 2026 (this version, v2)]

proposed_summary_revisions.summary_en: Tests option-channel attacks on seven open-weight models; reversed decisions can remain confident. The reported experiments do not test hosted Jev.
proposed_summary_revisions.summary_zh: 测试七个开放权重模型的选项通道攻击；决策翻转后仍可能高置信。报告中的实验未测试托管 Jev。
proposed_summary_revisions.reason: Keep the distinction between open-weight models and the hosted TypeSafe service explicit in the visible summary, not only in limitations.

proposed_summary_revisions.summary_en: Jev memory-retirement evaluation separates confirmed updates from suggestions; mixed LLM/human labels, shared errors and selection on a small development set constrain cascade claims.
proposed_summary_revisions.summary_zh: Jev 旧记忆停用评测区分已确认更新与变化暗示；LLM／人工混合标注、共享错误及小型开发集上的选择限制了级联收益主张。
proposed_summary_revisions.reason: Name the mixed labeling and shared-error/selection mechanisms; avoid implying that Jev already distinguishes every confirmed change correctly.

scope_findings.finding: Confidence calibration, missing-knowledge detection and knowledge self-report are distinct. Surface-cue controls weaken self-knowledge interpretations; no internal-state access is established.
Selected multiple-choice benchmarks and model set support bounded comparison only; not a universal model ranking or evidence of tool execution.
Seven open-weight models, with synthetic tool-call policies. Fail-open and fail-closed errors differ. Neither hosted Jev compromise nor failure of all possible defenses is established.

First submitted 2026-09-28; reviewed v2 dated 2026-10-03. Persona-conditioned English/Arabic outputs from one model are not measurements of national, age or gender populations, nor independent human respondents.

Three LLM annotators and two human adjudicators include an author. Shared gold/escalation-model errors and small-development-set selection limit cascade claims; the held-out finding must not be replaced by the better-looking development result.

Correctness of derived tool arguments is distinct from visible reference agreement. DeRef references are generated by a separate model; they are not independently verified ground truth or a guarantee that arbitrary tool calls are safe.

author_metadata_check.bibtex_handling: Preserve the exact primary citation_author string and all displayed name components; no inferred hyphenation, accent or surname repartition.

independent_review.hash_normalization: Abstract hashes independently reconstructed from whitespace-normalized text-node joins. Link boundaries retain a space before final punctuation, matching the candidate extraction. Primary page bytes also match for all six.
evidence_limits: Primary fixed-version abstracts and bibliographic metadata only; no full-paper review, code execution, dataset download or experiment reproduction.
All candidates remain abstract_checked with full_text_reviewed and editorial_reviewed false.
Code URLs are author-declared leads; contents were not checked in this review.
Public review contains original findings, bibliographic metadata and hashes only; no raw abstract body, contact email or local temporary path.

https://github.com/syntheme/beyond-answe: Black-box response tests do not establish access to internal knowledge states.
Full-prompt caches and upstream dataset text are not redistributed in this repository; some source datasets are noncommercial or lack stated licenses.
File presence and documentation were inspected; no experiment or table regeneration was executed.
https://github.com/arminazizi98/option-c: The evaluated models are open-weight systems, not the hosted TypeSafe Jev service.
GuardBench is generated from explicit rules, while third-party screening datasets are downloaded separately; no independent real-world prevalence claim is supported.
Cached artifacts and analysis scripts are present, but no code was executed and no defense or model result was independently reproduced.
https://github.com/sarielma/deref_releas: The README now links a separate evaluation-data release, but the repository does not include model outputs or cached results.
References are generated by another model and are not independently verified ground truth.
Generation/local judging requires external weights and hardware; hosted Jev calls require separate access. No pipeline execution or reproduction was performed.
https://huggingface.co/datasets/lm2445/D: The card identifies FC-RewardBench, ComplexFuncBench/AgentSuite trajectories and FinTrace as upstream sources.
Card and inventory checks confirm packaged files, not the correctness of every label or derivation path. No dataset rows were downloaded or independently adjudicated.
The four configurations and bootstrap sidecar are counted as one dataset resource, not separate discoveries.

author_artifacts.counting_scope: Three repositories and one separately released dataset with argument correctness/path labels and a source-relocation control. Four configurations and the bootstrap sidecar count within one dataset, not as independent task populations.
author_artifacts.reproduction: Primary documents and public file inventories only; no code, cached model evaluation or dataset row was executed or independently adjudicated.
